description: Adds an offset to a signal and scales it

inputs.text: With nothing patched to IN the output is the offset on its own, so it doubles as a constant voltage source

outputs.text: With nothing patched to IN the output is the offset on its own, so it doubles as a constant voltage source

menu: Disable output limit — lets the output go past the usual 12V cap
Order of operations — Scale, then offset multiplies first and adds the offset after; Offset, then scale adds first and multiplies after
